title: netops was granted sudo, but it still doesn't work
description_md:
The `netops` service account is supposed to have full passwordless `sudo` — someone added a drop-in file under `/etc/sudoers.d/` for it last week. But `sudo` for `netops` still fails every time, as if nothing was ever granted. SSH in as `trainee` (you have full passwordless `sudo`), work out why the grant isn't taking effect, and fix it properly.

You're done when `netops` can run a command via `sudo -n`.
